description: Parametrization of the portfolio (06) benchmark. Each physical data directory (instances/po_<base>/) holds only the lambda-free data (covariance + stock prices); the risk-aversion lambda is an objective coefficient applied at model-generation time. The full logical instance set is the cross product bases x lambda_grid, with the budget for each base derived from its asset count via budget_by_assets. This file is the single source of truth for the site builder (misc/ci/site_builder). See models/*/gen_archive.sh for the authoritative generation.
